name: custom-color-palette
description: Chrome MV3 extension that injects a brand color palette into the native Google Docs/Sheets/Slides color pickers.

scripts.test:service: cd service && if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q; else python3 -m pytest -q; fi
scripts.tier2: npm run lint && npm run typecheck:monitor && npm run test:service && npm run test:monitor
scripts.tier2:setup: cd monitor && npm install && cd ../service && python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/python -m pip install -q -r requirements-dev.txt
